milestone: Phase 7.4 — Executive Cyber Risk Dossier Generator

executive_summary.strategic_posture_summary: Critical security exposure detected: 3 verified/confirmed high-risk vulnerabilities present an immediate exploit trajectory requiring expedited emergency remediation.
key_business_concerns: Autonomous attack-chain synthesis confirmed 1 traversable multi-hop path(s) connecting perimeter entrypoints to sensitive backend assets.
Verified SQL Injection in Search Endpoint on https://target.corp/api/v1/products/search exposes organization to critical system compromise.
executive_recommendations: Review and apply proposed Priority 1 remediation diffs at perimeter entrypoints to immediately disrupt multi-hop traversal paths.
Deploy parameterized database query interfaces across all dynamic search and lookup handlers to eliminate injection risks.
Enforce strict tenant and object-level ownership checks across API endpoints prior to database record retrieval.
Schedule targeted live re-testing upon patch deployment to verify vulnerability resolution and issue clean Letter of Attestation.

financial_exposure.disclaimer: No monetary loss figures are fabricated. Empirical financial impact cannot be determined solely from vulnerability scanning without calibrated organizational telemetry (e.g. record valuations, SLA penalties, corporate revenue). Qualitative business impact and regulatory exposure categories are provided with explicit uncertainty ratings.
financial_exposure.methodology_notes: Qualitative impact model categorizing business disruption, regulatory exposure, and operational severity based on verified finding classes.
